avis.titre: High protection ideal for sensitive skin, with light appl...
avis.texte: The CETAPHIL SHER MINERAL SPF 50 sunscreen is an excellent option for those looking for effective and gentle protection for the skin. The application is easy and absorbs relatively quickly, ideal for both face and body. It does not irritate the eyes, which is a great plus point, especially for sensitive skin. As for the value I think it is worth it for the quality of its ingredients and the high protection it offers. It also works as a foundation for makeup if it is applied correctly.

avis.titre: Any type of skin can use it
avis.texte: This sunscreen feels lightweight on my skin and blends smoothly without leaving a heavy white cast. I like that it has spf 50 protection and works well for both face and body. The consistency is soft , non greasy, and comfortable for daily use. It also doesn't have a strong odor.

avis.titre: A lightweight, gentle sunscreen with strong protec

It provides strong coverage and protection, and while there is a slight white cast at first, it settles nicely. It wears comfortably throughout the day and doesn't leave a greasy residue.

avis.titre: Worst Sunscreen I have ever used

I also like that it sits well under makeup and doesn't pill. There is a slight white cast at first, but it fades as it absorbs into the skin. I feel confident knowing it's mineral-based and offers high SPF protection. Overall, it's a solid option for sensitive skin and daily sun protection, and I'd definitely recommend it.

I absolutely love this sunscreen! It's lightweight, non-greasy, and blends effortlessly into the skin without leaving a white cast. My sensitive skin usually reacts to sunscreens, but this one kept my face calm and hydrated all day. It's also water-resistant, which makes it ideal for beach days or workouts. Definitely a new favorite in my skincare routine!

used it and made my face look like I had white face paint. was not very great for the beach unfortunately. I guess if you like to tan and lay in the sun it would be fine but I'm more of an ocean and pool person.

I can buy cetaphil with no doubt, any product that is from cetaphil wheather it is moisture or a sunscreen lotion it gives the best results. And I have been using this product since a year it is a best product

i used it and it left a horrible white cast and would sometimes leave me purple-ish and im not dark what so ever… DONT EVER GET THIS SUNSCREEN!!!!

left white sticky residue everywhere. it's on my clothes, bag, and watch and won't come out. i don't recommend this product

avis.titre: I highly recommend it for anyone looking for effec

Plus, it's formulated with nourishing ingredients that keep my skin hydrated. Overall, Cetaphil Sheer Mineral Sunscreen has quickly become a staple in my skincare routine.
So far, one of the best sunscreen for my face, I lie the way to protect me also absorption. Super easy to carry highly recommended grey package one of the best

I was happy to see your sunscreen. Always loved your products. As far as sun protection product was great, however I was white all day. I have used other mineral sunscreens and the whiteness eventually goes away. Not this.

avis.titre: Hybrid 2 in 1 facial sunscreen and moisturizer
avis.texte: The best facial moisturizer sunscreen available. It absorbs easily and can be layered under or on top of other products. It has safe and good skin ingredients and the fragrance is super minimal. Leaves my skin protected and glowy

Beautiful mineral formula, blends beautifully under makeup and doesn't irritate or give rashes to my sensitive skin. Very silky and smooth, non sticky/greasy formula. I wish formulas like this existed when I was kid, I would have hated wearing sun screen so much

Horrible formula! I bought the 3 oz to take on a trip in my carryon. What a mistake! Had to throw it away and spend $$ on new sunscreen at the beach. Horrible layer of white - very difficult to rub in. Embarrassed at a holiday gathering when in a lit room & finally a teenager pointed out 'white stuff' in eyebrows & caked in wrinkles. Sorry I spent a good amount of money on this product!! Should get refund & apology.
Bought this for "sheer Mineral sunscreen" with zinc for protection

I bought Cetaphil because I like its products, but this sunscreen disappointed. It leaves a thick white layer and it's impossible to blend. For me, it was a huge waste of money, especially because it was supposed to be lightweight and it's completely the opposite.

avis.titre: Lotion stayed white on my arms and legs

avis.titre: Great mineral sunscreen for sensitive skin
